payout_quote: REFER A FRIEND & YOU BOTH GET PAID*! ... Once confirmed, member and referrer will receive $50.00 in the form of a deposit into their HFCU savings account which will be reported as taxable income.
steps: Be a Heritage Financial Credit Union member (New York's Hudson Valley).
Refer a friend to Heritage Financial CU (promo code: 50) and have them open a checking account with an activated debit card.
The new member keeps the checking account open with the debit card activated for 30 days after account opening.
Once confirmed, you and the new member each receive $50 deposited into your HFCU savings accounts.
catches: The newest official newsletter evidence is from 2023; the program is presented as ongoing ('offer may change or be discontinued at any time') but confirm it is still active before relying on it.
The friend must keep an open checking account with an activated debit card for 30 days - a savings-only membership does not qualify.
Business accounts are not eligible; offer is nontransferable.
biggest_catch: The friend needs an open checking account with an activated debit card for a full 30 days - and the official evidence is from 2023 newsletters, so confirm the program is still running.
eligibility: Heritage Financial Credit Union members; referred persons must be new members opening a checking account.
timing: Paid 'once confirmed' - after the new member completes 30 days with an open checking account and activated debit card.
